WIS.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable income rules
WIS.Settings.Enabled.Hint: When disabled, income is calculated normally (vanilla system behaviour).
WIS.Settings.Multiplier.Name: Multiplier
WIS.Settings.Divisor.Name: Divisor
WIS.Settings.Divisor.Hint: To make daily income 6× smaller: multiplier 1, divisor 6. Values ≤ 0 are treated as 1.
WIS.Settings.SLMode.Name: SL rule (success level)
WIS.Settings.SLMode.Hint: How the success level affects income.
WIS.Settings.SLPlus.Name: % per positive SL
WIS.Settings.SLPlus.Hint: Linear mode: each positive SL increases income by this %. Default 5.
WIS.Settings.SLMinus.Name: % per negative SL (failure)
WIS.Settings.SLMinus.Hint: Linear mode: on a failure, each |SL| subtracts this % more (on top of the failure penalty). Default 10. Result floored at 0.
WIS.Settings.FailPenalty.Name: Failure penalty (%)
WIS.Settings.FailPenalty.Hint: Linear mode: a failed test subtracts this % of income (base, regardless of SL). Default 25.
WIS.Settings.MinOne.Name: Minimum 1 penny on success
WIS.Settings.MinOne.Hint: If the result would be positive but scaling drops it to 0, pay at least 1 brass penny.
WIS.Settings.Visibility.Name: Breakdown visibility
WIS.Settings.Visibility.Hint: Who can see the income calculation breakdown.
WIS.Breakdown.Title: Income — breakdown
WIS.Settings.ApplyButton.Name: "Apply income" button
WIS.Settings.ApplyButton.Hint: Adds a button on the result card that adds the income to the character sheet (instead of dragging).
WIS.ApplyIncome.Label: Apply income
WIS.Settings.TalentBonuses.Name: Talent bonuses (Wealthy/Criminal)
WIS.Settings.TalentBonuses.Hint: Adds the Wealthy (+1 GC per rank) and Criminal (by career level × ranks) talent bonuses to base income (scaled by ÷ and SL).
WIS.Settings.PennyGranularity.Name: Rounding granularity
WIS.Settings.PennyGranularity.Hint: How finely to round income: whole penny or quarter-penny (0.25 — needs a quarter-penny coin on the sheet; half = two quarters).
WIS.Settings.QuarterSplit.Name: Split a penny into quarter-pennies
WIS.Settings.QuarterSplit.Hint: Adds a “▸ 960 QP” arrow to the money header on the sheet that splits 1 penny into 4 quarter-pennies (only when the sheet has a coin worth 0.25).
WIS.QuarterSplit.Error: No penny to split or no quarter-penny coin on the sheet.
